questions.question: Where should streaming results appear?
questions.notes: Compact dropdown that expands. Results stream in place. Click to navigate. ESC to dismiss.

questions.question: Visual feedback during EVOLVING phase (1-2s)?
questions.notes: Each result has shimmer effect. Items physically reorder with animation as AI scores arrive.

questions.question: How is DEEP search triggered?
questions.notes: Button for discoverability ('Go Deeper'), Shift+Enter for power users.

questions.question: How do current presets map to Progressive tiers?
questions.notes: Progressive is default. Settings lets user force a specific tier if needed.

analysis: Phase 2 Progressive Search will have: (1) Dropdown results below Omnibar, (2) Shimmer effect with animated reordering during AI evaluation, (3) 'Go Deeper' button + Shift+Enter for deep search, (4) Settings presets kept as fallback/override.
